subject: astronomy
title: Space Exploration Foundations
welcome_lead: From Sputnik to JWST — trace humanity's reach into the cosmos.
meta_desc: GCSE Astronomy: history and uses of space exploration, telescopes and satellites.
final_note: You can outline the major milestones of space exploration.

concepts.def: First artificial satellite, launched by USSR in 1957.
First human in space, 1961, aboard Vostok 1.
International Space Station, continuously crewed since 2000.
Optical/UV telescope in low Earth orbit, launched 1990.
James Webb Space Telescope, infrared, launched Dec 2021.

walkthroughs.body_html: 1957: Sputnik 1. 1961: Gagarin orbits Earth. 1969: Apollo 11 lands on the Moon. 1998: ISS construction begins. 2020: SpaceX Crew Dragon — first private crewed orbital launch.
Earth's atmosphere blurs and absorbs much light, especially infrared and UV. Space telescopes like Hubble (1990) and JWST (2021) avoid this and see sharper, deeper images.
NASA's Artemis programme aims to return humans to the Moon and prepare for Mars. Many nations now have space programmes, alongside private companies like SpaceX and Blue Origin.
